advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Bound or make non-blocking the lease-loss diagnostic probe (or drop the `remote=` force-fetch) so it cannot delay `lock_lost.set()` by up to `_REMOTE_TIMEOUT_SECS`.
evidence: __main__.py:303-304 comment: 'it must never mask or delay the abort'
_ref_lock.py:403-405 `if remote is not None: _fetch_ref(repo_root, ref, remote)`
`self.lock_lost.set()` at __main__.py:326 runs only after the probe returns, so a slow probe delays the main pass's abort detection
advisory.finding: The lease-loss diagnostic probe calls `read(..., remote=_lock_remote(...))`, which force-syncs the ref from the remote via a `git fetch` bounded by `_REMOTE_TIMEOUT_SECS = 30.0`; under network latency/hang this blocks up to ~30s before `self.lock_lost.set()` runs, delaying the abort — directly contradicting the comment/test claim that the probe 'never masks or delays the abort'.

Only test with a live state uses oid='b'*40 (foreign) while held is 'a'*40: `state = types.SimpleNamespace(holder="other-pass-2026", ... oid="b" * 40)` (test file:69-71)
Code renders both cases via the same branch (src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py:313-317) but the same-oid outcome — where ref oid == our held oid — is never asserted.
ABSENCE: no test constructs a state whose oid equals the held oid ('a'*40) to assert the CAS-failed-for-other-reason interpretation is distinguishable in stderr.
advisory.finding: The new test file omits the case the change was written to disambiguate: the ref still carrying OUR OWN oid (CAS failed for a non-takeover reason). Tests cover a different holder and an unreadable probe only, so the 'takeover vs. same-oid CAS failure' distinction the ticket exists to prove is unverified.
merged_from: The 'our own oid still on the ref' case — the central takeover-vs-CAS-failure distinction the change exists to make provable — is untested. Only the DIFFERENT-holder takeover case is exercised (holder='other-pass-2026', ref oid='b'*40 while we held 'a'*40). No test drives the case where the ref still carries our own oid, so a regression that fails to render or mislabels that state (making a spurious CAS failure look like a real takeover, the exact ambiguity being removed) would not be caught.
